thread.title: UK High Court Blocks Lawsuit Against Google

author: morningstar.com
title: UK High Court Blocks Lawsuit Against Google

organizations.name: adria calatayud the u.k. high court
uk high court blocks lawsuit against google

text:
By Adria Calatayud
The U.K. High Court blocked Monday a 3 billion-pound ($3.93 billion) lawsuit against Alphabet Inc.'s (GOOG) Google, alleging the company secretly tracked the internet activity of users of Apple Inc.'s (AAPL) iPhone.
The court dismissed an application to serve proceedings on the U.S. technology giant, saying that the facts didn't support the claim that iPhone users suffered damage and that it would be impossible reliably to ascertain the number of users who might be affected.
However, the court said there is no dispute that Google's alleged role in the collection, collation and use of data was wrongful and a breach of duty.
Google has previously settled claims in the U.S. stemming from the tracking, after The Wall Street Journal reported in 2012 that Google and other companies had tracked iPhone users without their consent in 2011 and 2012.
